intro.header: Searching for apartments in City of Orange, NJ
content: Are you looking for apartments in City of Orange and want to know more about the area? We have information about the city and its residents that can assist you.
The closest neighboring cities are Jersey City, a little under 10 miles from City of Orange, and Newark, a little over three miles away.

transportation.header: Transportation in City of Orange, NJ
content: If you enjoy traveling out of town, you're in luck. There are a couple of different transportation options close by so you'll easily be able to book your next trip. You can fly from Newark Liberty International Airport, which is six miles away from City of Orange, or as an alternative you can also fly from La Guardia Airport, which is 19 miles away. The nearest train depot is Penn Station, four miles away. Also, six miles away from City of Orange is Liberty International Airport Station.
